completionOps.title: Story Sync: Inside Track
completionOps.summary: Bin turns Frosted Mug gossip into a real lead: courier, route, and a usable schedule.

nodes.text: The Frosted Mug cellar runs cold. Two barrels. One trapdoor. A walking-around stain on the floor that is not from spilled ale, and a tally chalked on the back of a brick that nobody wants to claim drew it.

nodes.speaker: Tavern Host
nodes.text: If you are here for the ghosts, the ghosts left an hour ago. If you are here for the inquiries, sit down before I lose my nerve. I should have told someone weeks ago.

nodes.speaker: Peri
nodes.text: Listen to her. She is the most honest cowardice in this entire town. That is a compliment. It is the kind of compliment the system files under 'useful.'

nodes.speaker: Bin
nodes.text: Tell me what happened in your own order, not mine. I am not the law and I am not in a hurry. The system can wait, the town can wait, you cannot.

nodes.speaker: Bin
nodes.text: Sorry. I almost said something stupid. Take your time. The cellar is not on fire. Please tell me before the cellar is on fire.

nodes.speaker: Tavern Host
nodes.text: A courier comes on market days. Comes in on the south gate, asks two questions about Garr's hut, leaves three silver, leaves. Never twice in a row. Never says a name. Pays in coin nobody recognizes. Last visit was six days ago.

nodes.prompt: How does Bin handle the courier lead?

choices.label: Plan to bring this to the town meeting
choices.summary: Share with Frostbitten openly. Lower danger.

ops.text: Bin agreed to surface the courier at the town meeting.

choices.label: Keep it inside the family first
choices.summary: Quiet. Costs trust with the gate later if discovered.

ops.text: Bin chose to keep the courier lead inside Garr's circle for now.

nodes.speaker: Tavern Host
nodes.text: Thank you. I will not stop you, but I will warn you. The courier has Frostbitten friends. People will not be glad to hear their names said out loud at a town meeting.

nodes.speaker: Tavern Host
nodes.text: Family it is. I owe you the names, and I owe Garr two of them. Take them home, decide what stays inside the walls.

nodes.speaker: Peri
nodes.text: Good. Now we walk you home before this turns into a domestic emergency. The town meeting is the next chapter no matter which fork you took. Try to arrive with both hands free.

nodes.summary: Route B is filed and points at the same town meeting as Route A.

ops.text: Frosted Mug cellar yielded a usable courier lead. The town meeting in 1.3.a will hear it.
